comments.author: @GlobeLifeHidden
comments.text: The most incredible thing isn't the floating houses- it's how an entire community has learned to survive together. When one boat breaks or a house starts sinking, neighbors simply show up. Would you be able to live this way?

comments.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
comments.text: 🏠 One of the wildest things is that an entire house can rise and fall with the river like a natural elevator. If the anchoring system fails, the whole home can drift away.

comments.author: @AmazingDiscoveriesTopUS
comments.text: Living  on a floating house where the river can rise 14 meters, crocodiles swim below and your neighbors become your emergency rescue team... this is a completely different definition of home.
